    - heading "Accessibility" [level=2]
    - list:
      - listitem: Shortcuts work while the focus is anywhere inside – a click on plain content keeps them working; buttons carry aria-keyshortcuts
      - listitem: Every action is a real button; the reason picker is a labelled group
      - listitem: Queue rows show only the title, the type and the waiting time; as buttons they are labelled with title, type, risk, confidence and waiting time; the current one has aria-current
      - listitem: Flagged spans are focusable and point to their note with aria-describedby (role tooltip)
      - listitem: Decisions, skips and undos are announced in a polite live region, with the new count
      - listitem: When the row or field you were on leaves, the focus moves to the next item instead of getting lost
    - heading "Motion" [level=2]
    - list:
      - listitem: "Calm and quick: a decided row shows a small check or cross where its time was, fades and closes up (about 300ms)"
      - listitem: The decided item fades up a few pixels while the next one follows a beat later from just below – the same soft ease as Trace Waterfall
      - listitem: The pressed button flashes its decision's tint for a moment; the progress bar glides on
      - listitem: Items that arrive open their row at their sorted spot with a soft highlight
      - listitem: J and K slide the item up or down; the agent's note opens with a small scale and fade
      - listitem: With prefers-reduced-motion everything changes at once
    - heading "Responsive behavior" [level=2]
    - list:
      - listitem: "Built on a container query: wide, the queue sits on the left and the item on the right, in a fixed-height workspace"
      - listitem: Under 640px the queue goes on top, three rows high, the item under it; its box glides to each item's height; buttons share the width
      - listitem: Under 420px the agent line wraps between its parts instead of cutting them, button icons step aside and the flag counter hides – flags are tapped directly; diffs scroll sideways
      - listitem: "Dark mode built in: switches when an ancestor (usually <html>) has the class dark or data-theme=\"dark\""
    - heading "Notes for AI" [level=2]
    - paragraph: Give your coding assistant this summary instead of screenshots.
    - list:
      - listitem: Pass every waiting item – the component sorts, filters and hides what's decided; keep ids stable
      - listitem: For code, pass files with a unified diff (git diff output works once split into its files); put a flag on the exact expression that worries the agent, not on a whole line
      - listitem: Flag only the spans the agent is genuinely unsure about, each with a one-line note and, if you have it, its source
      - listitem: createdAt is when the item started waiting, not when the agent run started
      - listitem: If you remove decided items from items in onDecide, add them back in onUndo
      - listitem: Colors are variables on .ui-rvcc, e.g. --ui-rvcc-flag-bg / --ui-rvcc-flag-edge for the flagged spans; --ui-rvcc-height sets the workspace height
      - listitem: The icons are Hugeicons Free (MIT) – keep the credit comment when you copy the file
